title: Cohomology of moduli spaces of pointed curves
summary: In this paper, after reviewing recent progress on the cohomology of $\overline{\cal M}_{0,n}$, we further our investigation on the cohomology of moduli spaces of pointed curves in continuation of [2,4,5,6,7,8]. In particular, we prove that the Betti number distribution of the Fulton-MacPherson compactification $C[n]$ of the space of $n$ ordered distinct points on any smooth projective curve $C$ is asymptotically Gaussian as $n$ goes to infinity.
